GTO posture for non-PFA OOP-early in multiway SRP with a strong combo draw:
  - CHECK is the modal action because hero realizes equity well in checked pots (passive flow, multi-villain protection).
  - BET at small sizing (~33%) as a semi-bluff is defensible because hero has high outs + position-leverage on later streets... BUT hero is OOP-EARLY with 3 villains behind (CO and BTN have position). Position-disadvantage cuts the semi-bluff EV.
  - The decisive factor: hero faces 3 ranges with significant continuation density (CO and BTN will float with overcards, gutshots, mid-pair). Fold equity per villain in 4-way SRP is ~25-30%; multiplied vs 3 villains the realized fold equity is ~50% probability of all-folding to one bet. That's low.

Counter-arg for BET (semi-bluff): the 8-out wrap is high-equity-realization. Betting gets value from worse draws (hero is ahead of 6-5, 7-5, 7-3 type weak combo draws) and isolates the field. BUT in 4-way SRP, betting a non-pair-hand from MP OOP risks getting raised by 87s/65s/76s overpair (no, those don't exist preflop SRP) — raised by a flopped two pair or set (76, 77, 66, 44 sets) from any of 3 villains.
